256.title: God is with us when we stand for what is right
summary: Daniel and his friends were taken far from home to Babylon. Even in a place where many people did not follow God, they chose to honor Him. God gave them wisdom and helped them stay faithful.

When King Nebuchadnezzar had a dream no one could explain, God showed Daniel what it meant. Daniel gave God the credit. The dream reminded everyone that human kingdoms do not last forever, but God is always in control.

Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego later refused to worship a golden statue. They were thrown into a fiery furnace, but God protected them. They learned that following God is worth doing even when it is difficult or scary.
256.takeaway: You can choose what is right even when other people choose differently. God is with His people in difficult moments, and He is more powerful than anything we face.
